verdict.rationale: Docs analytics is a fair question for a documentation site generator, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no page-view analytics, search-term reporting, or reader-feedback capability. Algolia DocSearch support covers search itself, not insight into what readers search for, and the pluggable architecture and React components are only building blocks a developer could use to add analytics.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I see page views, search terms, and reader feedback so I know which docs work and which fail
